original_ai_output.title_zh: 加纳议员律师称SIC文件已交还客户，EOCO无权搜查其律所
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 加纳Manhyia South选区议员Nana Agyei Baffour Awuah的律师Samuel Atta Akyea表示，经济与有组织犯罪办公室（EOCO）对其客户律所的搜查可能违反保密法。Atta Akyea称相关SIC文件已交还客户，EOCO没有理由搜查该律所。此前有报道称Baffour Awuah已被正式指控洗钱和造成公共资金损失。

key_facts.fact: 加纳议员Nana Agyei Baffour Awuah的律师称EOCO对其客户律所的搜查可能违反保密法
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Samuel Atta Akyea, lawyer for Manhyia South MP Nana Agyei Baffour Awuah, has warned that the ongoing search of his client's law firm by the Economic and Organised Crime Office (EOCO) could breach confidentiality laws.

key_facts.fact: 律师称SIC文件已交还客户，EOCO没有理由搜查该律所
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: SIC file was surrendered to client, EOCO has no reason to search Manhyia South MP's firm – Atta Akyea

key_facts.fact: 据律师称，Baffour Awuah已被正式指控洗钱和造成公共资金损失
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Baffour Awuah formally charged with money laundering, loss of public funds – Lawyer
Baffour Awuah to spend night in EOCO custody – Atta Akyea

uncertainties: 相关指控与搜查理由目前仅来自单一来源（律师陈述），尚未获得独立证实
事件时间存在差异（冲突标记：time_difference）
